observations: Art: Inspected all 36 final vehicle captures as six labelled six-view sheets, plus the Urus front PNG at original resolution. Jeep/Bronco, Civic, Sprinter and HUMMER retain open windscreen/cabin views and bounded dark glazing borders through front, side and rear angles.

Art: The Urus front close view shows three recessed circular optical units per lamp inside the angular covers, retained light guides and unobstructed dark fascia intakes. Side/rear glazing perimeters remain continuous without a new opaque central pane.

Art: The new pass adds incremental glazing and Urus optical geometry. Body silhouettes, panel corners, some door reflections, trim and interiors remain simplified procedural reconstructions; this is not Forza-level body surfacing.

Detail: Inspected all six final Detail captures, with the meadow-close and snow-scan-close PNGs also at original resolution. The meadow has green, straw and exposed-soil photographic variation; the prior washed-out yellow candidate is not the accepted package.

Detail: The snow close view retains fine grain and meandering low wind ripples without blowing the whole floor to white. Wide drift relief remains subtle; the snow edge breaks into brown/green soil rather than a straight material line.

Detail: Remaining visual limits include sparse/large grass clumps, some repeated ground motifs and simplified/blocky acquired snow-cliff silhouettes. No production-quality environment or new collision relief is claimed.

Ruts: Inspected all 16 current controlled and actual-driven rut PNGs across the three contact sheets. Mud and wet-grass fixtures show rounded continuous grooves and broad darker soil shoulders; hard dirt and sand remain much shallower and lighter.

Ruts: Both actual motor-drive images show continuous wheel paths behind the Jeep. Snow floors are pale blue-grey with retained white banks and visible tread shading, without the rejected dark navy/black appearance. Mud remains moist brown rather than pavement rubber.
Ruts: Physical geometry and soil response are unchanged this round. Fine profile shading remains stylized and physical individual tread-lug geometry/liquid mud is not claimed.
